hooks.command: bash -c 'D="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -f "$D/hooks/gate.sh" ]; then exit 0; fi; echo "WIGTN 경고: 커밋 품질 게이트가 **비활성**입니다 — hooks/gate.sh 경로를 해석하지 못했습니다. 커밋이 객관 체크 없이 통과합니다. (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT 미확장 또는 플러그인 설치 손상)" >&2; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); PROBE=$(echo "$CMD" | tr -d "\42\47"); if echo "$PROBE" | grep -qE "rm( +-[A-Za-z-]+){0,3} +(-\w*[rR]\w*f\w*|-\w*f\w*[rR]\w*|-[rR] +-f|-f +-[rR]|--recursive +--force|--force +--recursive) +(/|~|[$]HOME|[$][{]HOME[}])(/?([[:space:]]|$)|/?\*)|git\s+push\s+.*--force|git\s+push\s+.*-f\s|git\s+reset\s+--hard|[Dd][Rr][Oo][Pp]\s+([Dd][Aa][Tt][Aa][Bb][Aa][Ss][Ee]|[Tt][Aa][Bb][Ll][Ee]|[Ss][Cc][Hh][Ee][Mm][Aa])"; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected. Please confirm before executing: $CMD" >&2; exit 2; fi'
bash -c 'D="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -f "$D/hooks/gate.sh" ]; then exec bash "$D/hooks/gate.sh"; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(tsx?|jsx?|css|scss)$"; then echo "Reminder: Run formatter (prettier/eslint) on $FILE before committing."; fi'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(ts|js|py|go|java)$"; then echo "Reminder: Verify backend pattern compliance (error handling, input validation, logging) for $FILE."; fi'
bash -c 'echo "Pipeline session complete. Review changes before pushing."'
